verdict.rationale: The 01 is a voice-driven computer-control agent that can "control third-party software," so how it perceives and locates UI elements is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence documents its element-location method (accessibility tree, OCR, set-of-marks, or coordinates) or any way to debug misclicks. The profile customization docs cover behavior, model and system message, not screen perception.
